consumerBoundary.rule: traffic-reporter is sole Shared Traffic Feed content authority; consumers must never re-judge completedProducts

git.exportArtifactCommit: uncommitted-at-generation-time (resolved by git history, never self-referenced)
git.selfReferenceNote: sourceMainHead is the official main commit this snapshot DESCRIBES; exportArtifactCommit is the commit that CONTAINS this artifact and is intentionally never equal to it. Requiring the two to match would create a Git self-reference loop (every export changes the file, which changes the commit, which invalidates the recorded head). sourceMainHead is read from origin/main and is therefore stable across re-runs and across whichever branch the export was generated on.
git.checkoutNote: The transient checkout (branch/HEAD/date) this export happened to run from is deliberately NOT recorded here. It changes on every commit and would make every release look like a content change, defeating delta sync; it also says nothing about the snapshot itself. The snapshot is identified by sourceMainHead alone. Local sync evidence in .engineering/ still records the checkout for auditing.
git.workingTreeNote: sourceWorkingTree excludes meeting-room-export/, which this generator dirties by definition; it answers 'is the source tree clean', not 'did the export just write files'.

broadcastMode.majorAccidentRule: pushed <=> passes the V1.5 whitelist AND type === 'accident' AND not a dynamic-shoulder event. type==='accident' is the EXISTING classifier decision, not a new severity judgement.
broadcastMode.whyNoSeverityKeywordGate: No severity field exists in this codebase and PBS records carry no structured impact field, so requiring impact keywords would be a guess that errs toward withholding serious crashes. Impact evidence is RECORDED instead (policy-major-accident-* vs policy-accident-no-stated-impact) so the one-month review can tighten against real counts. Full reasoning: 07_KNOWN_ISSUES.md and src/traffic/broadcastPolicy.js.
broadcastMode.whyTdxOff: TDX API quota exhausted (2026-08-23). Deliberate pause, not a fault; no TDX code deleted.
broadcastMode.whyShoulderPushPaused: LINE OA monthly proactive-Push allowance is limited; 機動路肩 is high-frequency. Detection/parser/formatter/CCTV strategy all preserved — only the proactive product is withheld.
broadcastMode.whyCctvAllowed: CCTV costs ZERO TDX calls: metadata from the read-only KV cache, frames from *.freeway.gov.tw, and cctv/dynamicCollage.js imports neither tdx/auth.js nor tdx/client.js. Structural guarantee, not a promise.
broadcastMode.serviceAreaNote: PBS_ONLY does NOT mean 'any PBS event anywhere can broadcast'. TDX_CORROBORATION_REQUIRED=false and SERVICE_AREA_ELIGIBILITY_REQUIRED=true are independent and must stay that way. Enforced by traffic/serviceArea.js, checked FIRST in the broadcast eligibility loop in every source mode. It reuses the canonical resolvers (pbs/hsinchuFilter.js, traffic/hsinchuFilter.js) — no new geographic engine, and the area was neither widened nor narrowed.
broadcastMode.serviceAreaRegressionCase: 2026-08-24: a PBS 國道1號南向 accident at 八堵 (基隆, 25.10288/121.71801) was pushed to LINE. Geography was filtered only at PBS ingestion; broadcastPipeline.js documented the assumption and never enforced it. Permanent fixture: test/serviceAreaGate.test.js.
broadcastMode.serviceAreaHonestLimit: The ingestion-path leak could NOT be reproduced from the available data — isPbsEventHsinchuRelevant blocks 八堵 in every raw shape tried (with/without coordinates, with/without a parseable KM, swapped lat/lng). The fix is the missing enforcement at the broadcast boundary, not a patch to a reproduced hole. If the raw PBS record ever surfaces, re-check ingestion.
broadcastMode.serviceAreaPbsVsTdx: PBS is FAIL-CLOSED (it carries its geography to the broadcast layer, so the gate re-runs the exact ingestion function). TDX blocks only on POSITIVE out-of-area evidence, because tdx/normalize.js keeps road/KM but not raw Positions while ingestion admits on coordinates OR road+KM — judging TDX fail-closed here would silently drop valid TDX traffic once KM is missing, and would only surface after TDX is restored. Measured: the fail-closed version broke 35 existing TDX-fixture tests.
broadcastMode.locationQualityNote: 事故通過服務區域與重大事故政策後，還必須具備司機可行動的位置才准主動 LINE Push。判定層級（全部沿用既有 resolver，無新地理引擎、無硬編 KM、不猜位置）：結構化 KM（區段 > MAX_ACTIONABLE_SEGMENT_KM=15 公里者不算） / displayKM / 座標且既有 resolver 能可靠轉成可理解地點 / 訊息真的會印出來的地點文字含明確 KM、交流道匝道路口隧道、或行政區＋更細地點。實作於 traffic/locationQuality.js，位置在服務區域與事故政策之後、時間 dedupe suppression 之前。
broadcastMode.locationQualityThresholdBasis: MAX_ACTIONABLE_SEGMENT_KM=15 取自 bundled 官方交流道資料集（交通部高速公路局）：國道一號與國道三號相鄰設施間距 p50 4 公里、p95 11 公里、最大 15 公里；新竹服務區間最寬是竹林－寶山 8 公里。比全國最寬的交流道間距還長的區段，不可能被描述成「哪兩個交流道之間」。資料集若更新請重新量測，永遠不得為了讓某一筆事件通過而放寬。
broadcastMode.threeGatesIndependent: TDX_CORROBORATION_REQUIRED=false（PBS_ONLY） / SERVICE_AREA_REQUIRED=true（永遠） / LOCATION_QUALITY_REQUIRED=true（永遠）。三者回答三個不同問題：有沒有被佐證、是不是我們的地盤、駕駛能不能用。任何一個都不得被另一個取代或推論。八堵即使位置精確仍必須被服務區域擋下（有專門測試鎖住）。
broadcastMode.locationQualityRegressionCase: 2026-08-24 約 14:20 的真實 Push：「🚨 交通事故 / 台68 西向 /（南寮竹東）-台68線 / 事故影響通行 / 🕒 13:48更新」。第三行是 PBS 對整條台68 的官方路線名稱（南寮 0.4K、竹東 22.9K），不是事故地點。永久 fixture：test/pbsAccidentTraceLocationQuality.test.js。
broadcastMode.locationQualityRepairBeforeBlock: 施工令要求先分辨「上游沒給」與「上游有給但我們丟掉」。丟掉的是座標：pbs/normalize.js 一直把 x1/y1 保留成 latitude/longitude，但顯示側從來沒有任何一行讀過它（resolveKmLocation 從 KM 出發，而 PBS 沒有 KM），所以有座標與無座標產生的訊息逐位元組相同。已新增 kmLocationResolver.js 的 resolveCoordinateLocation（既有 KM 查詢的反向版本，同一份 bundled 官方資料、同樣 fail-closed、0 網路），messageFormat.js 只在完全沒有 KM 時才呼叫，既有訊息一則都不改變。
broadcastMode.locationQualityHonestLimit: 沙箱對外 egress 為 403，無法讀取 Production KV 或 admin 端點，因此該筆的原始 PBS 記錄與真實 rawId(UID) 並未取得。source=PBS、areaNm、updatedAt=13:48、無可解析 KM 等結論，是從訊息本身逐行比對 messageFormat.js 反推的，可由 test/pbsAccidentTraceLocationQuality.test.js 第 1 項重現。「原始資料是否帶座標」無法判定——因為修正前有無座標產生的訊息完全相同。若日後取得該筆原始記錄，請回頭核對。
broadcastMode.deliveryTraceGapRootCause: Trace 有寫入（broadcastPipeline.js 對 allEvents 每一筆都建 entry，四個 return 都會 finalizeTrace）。斷點全在讀取側：(1) /health 是 counts-only 快照，本來就不查單一事件；(2) road 篩選是嚴格相等，trace 存正規化後的「台68」，而人看到的每個字面都是「台68線」，照螢幕上的字搜必定 0 筆；(3) 同一次 Cron 的所有 entry 共用同一個 now，key 只靠隨機 opaqueId 排序，同輪順序隨機，預設 30 筆時會不定時被擠出第一頁；(4) 掃描上限 500 筆時，「沒掃到」與「不存在」回報成同一件事。
broadcastMode.deliveryTraceGapFix: road 篩選改用 pipeline 自己的正規化函式比對（台68／台68線／國1／國道1號 互通，不同路永不互相命中）；新增關鍵字搜尋（道路／地點／訊息內容／rawId／reason）；trace key 加入批次序號使同輪順序穩定；listPipelineTrace 回報 scanTruncated／scannedKeyCount／totalKeyCount，查詢頁在 0 筆時明講「查不到不等於沒發生」。永久要求：任何實際進入 Shared Feed / LINE Push 的事故，都必須能從管理後台追回 Producer provenance。
broadcastMode.locationQualityDoesNotUseCctv: CCTV 仍是 optional enrichment。找到 CCTV 不能讓一筆整條道路級的模糊事故送出；位置夠精確但沒有 CCTV 仍可 TEXT-ONLY 播報。兩者互不影響，有測試鎖住。
broadcastMode.locationQualityNeverThrows: 位置不足只會讓該筆不推播，永遠不會 throw pipeline，事件仍完整保留在 Pipeline Trace，標記 broadcast=blocked / reason=insufficient-location-precision，未來才知道它為什麼沒播。
broadcastMode.freewayGateNote: V57.2's 國道 gate (pbs/crossSourceDedup.js) drops an unmatched PBS 國道 event so a more authoritative TDX report can decide instead. That premise fails in PBS_ONLY: TDX is off, no TDX event can arrive, and the gate becomes a permanent veto by a disabled source (a real Production accident was dropped this way on 2026-08-24). The gate is now mode-aware via requireTdxCorrelationForFreeway, derived from isTdxRuntimeEnabled(env). BYPASSED, never deleted — TRAFFIC_SOURCE_MODE=ALL restores V57.2 unchanged, and the option defaults to true so a forgetful caller stays conservative.
broadcastMode.freewayGateDoesNotWidenPush: Bypassing the gate only lets 國道 PBS events reach the candidate list. Eligibility, the accident-only push policy, the time window, dedupe and suppression all still apply, so dynamic shoulder and every non-accident type remain withheld.
broadcastMode.cctvIsNotBroadcastEligibility: CCTV is enrichment, never a precondition. A qualifying PBS accident broadcasts TEXT-ONLY when CCTV yields nothing; refusing to broadcast because there is no image is forbidden.
broadcastMode.linePushObservationPurpose: Observe one month of real proactive-Push volume under the accident-only policy, then tune with data.
broadcastMode.pushPolicyRestorePath: set LINE_PUSH_POLICY=ALL_ELIGIBLE in wrangler.jsonc and push

linePushObservation.purpose: Confirm whether the accident-only policy keeps proactive LINE pushes inside the OA plan's 200/month allowance. Observation only — this is NOT an open engineering task.
linePushObservation.billingMonthCaveat: The LINE allowance resets on a CALENDAR month. The observation started 2026-08-23, so 8/23-9/22 is NOT one billing month and its total must never be read as one. Any judgement has to be made per calendar month (Aug 23-31 is a partial month), against the real LINE console figures.
linePushObservation.evidenceRule: Only figures a human actually read from the LINE console count as observation evidence. This repo cannot see LINE usage; never estimate, extrapolate, or infer a push count from event counts or logs, and never record an unmeasured number here.
linePushObservation.measurementSource: LINE Official Account Manager console (human-read). No billing/metering system was built for this — that was explicitly out of scope.
linePushObservation.decisionThreshold: Well under 200 -> keep the current policy. At or over 200 -> a HUMAN opens a new task to study a stricter ROAD_IMPACT_ACCIDENT / lane-blockage-only rule. Claude must not tighten the policy on its own initiative.
linePushObservation.supportingSignal: broadcastPolicy.js already records, per pushed accident, whether the record stated real road impact (policy-major-accident-blocked-lanes / -impact-keyword vs policy-accident-no-stated-impact). Those counts are visible in ineligibleByReason and the Pipeline Trace, and are what a future tightening should be argued from — not guesswork.
linePushObservation.readerNote: OBSERVATION, not construction. Do not modify src/, the broadcast policy, Cron, TDX, CCTV, the Consumer, or redeploy because of this entry.
